question: How do some practitioners approach that plenary state?
premises: Some are minded to worship that plenary state part by part
They approach it through divisions arising as one, doubled, four, six, twelve, and so on
These divisions are modes of engaging the same state
inference: Practitioners approach the one plenary consciousness through graduated numerical differentiations.
plain_english: Some, wishing to worship that very state part by part, do so through divisions arising as one, twofold, four, six, twelve, and so forth.
